message.content:
It depends on which dessert you’re thinking of—sweet treats come in almost every hue! Here are a few common examples:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) | Why it looks that way |
|---------|------------------|-----------------------|
| Chocolate cake | Dark brown (sometimes with a glossy chocolate glaze) | Cocoa powder and melted chocolate give it that rich brown tone. |
| Vanilla sponge | Pale ivory or off‑white | The batter is light, and any vanilla extract adds a subtle yellowish tint. |
| Strawberry shortcake | Pink | Fresh strawberries and whipped cream give a rosy hue. |
| Lemon meringue pie | Yellow‑golden (crust) with a fluffy white meringue | Lemon curd is bright yellow; meringue is beaten egg whites, so it’s white. |
| Fruit tart | Multicolored | A mix of fresh fruit (berries, kiwi, mango, etc.) on a buttery crust. |
| Ice cream | Depends on flavor – vanilla (white), chocolate (brown), strawberry (pink), mint (green) | The base color comes from the flavoring or added food dyes. |

If you had a specific dessert in mind, let me know and I can give a more precise answer!
